note: Petition: reduced by weakness of sight to use lunettes; asks relief as greffier and provision as conseiller clerc (Nov 1416).
Jeudi xij jour de novembre 1416 — still recording Parlement (Chancellor Henry de Marie session).
Mardi xvij jour de novembre 1416 — greffe near-work continues after spectacle petition month.
Lundi vij jour de décembre — cure vacancy plea recorded.
Samedi xix jour de décembre — Court detention orders recorded.
Prestation de serment as conseiller; greffier until this day; successor Clément de Fauquembergue.
Mercredi xxvij janvier: Chancellor elects new graphier/greffier in assembled chambers (Baye transition).
Plaidoiries 10 May 1417 (Matinées) — Baye still active in Paris clerical/legal near-work orbit.
Late Dec 1417: with Jean des Landes visits upper church for chapitre administration.
Last hard pin: regularly on conseiller present lists until 28 Mar 1418 (eve of Burgundian entry to Paris). years_after=2 from 1416.
June 1418 massacres; Parlement suspended from 10 June — office ends. Soft activity terminus.
